The '''Ostega Orbital Yards''' were [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Ostega]]. They were used by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Kligson/Legends|Kligson]] to build [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]].
